summary: The root لَهَمَ (lhm) primarily means for God to inspire or direct someone towards good or prosperity. It also signifies suggesting something to someone or putting an idea into their mind.
lane: 4 أَلْهَمَهُ ٱللّٰهُ لِلْخَيْرِ ذ [ God directed him by inspiration to that which was good, or to prosperity ] (TA, art. وفق ) -b2- أَلْهَمَهُ إِيَّاهُ He suggested it to him; (in the order of the words, he suggested to him it; ) he put it into his mind.
